body.purpose: Default reading text throughout the app.

mono-dose.purpose: Reserved for numeric doses/concentrations in Mindmap-formatted notes; primary UI uses Inter tabular figures for on-screen dose numbers.

label.purpose: Bottom nav labels and small chip text, 10-12px, checked independently for AA at that size.

mindmap-emphasis.purpose: Formal emphasis inside Mindmap note formatting only, never in main app chrome.

mindmap-heading.purpose: Headings/emphasis inside Mindmap note formatting only, never in main app chrome.

shadows.name: floating-layer
shadows.purpose: Reserved for genuinely elevated layers: pickers, toasts, modals, sheets. Never used on resting cards.

motion.name: ease-bounce
motion.purpose: Tap/selection feedback and delight entrances (tab pop, card rise-in, nav pill grow). Never applied to danger/warning states.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Disclosure expand/collapse and other functional (non-delight) transitions.

components.name: Primary Tab Chip (active)
components.description: Selected tab in a horizontal-scroll tab row (e.g. Dùng thuốc screen). Plays a bounce pop on selection.
components.css: .ds-tab-chip { height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: transform 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1), background-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease; } .ds-tab-chip:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-tab-chip--active { background: #003152; color: #ffffff; animation: ds-pulse-scale 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); } @keyframes ds-pulse-scale { 0% { transform: scale(0.8); } 55% { transform: scale(1.12); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }

components.name: Primary Tab Chip (inactive)
components.description: Unselected tab in the same row.

components.name: Resource Card
components.description: Home-screen quick-access card. Flat at rest, no shadow; scales down on press; staggers in on mount.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 136px; height: 152px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #dae9e9; background: #ffffff; text-align: left; display: flex; flex-direction: column; transition: transform 0.1s; animation: ds-rise-in 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.9, 0.35, 1) backwards; } .ds-card:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #003152; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 8px; background: #003152; color: #ffffff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-label { font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; color: #0d2324; } @keyframes ds-rise-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid primary action button (e.g. 'Thêm vào danh sách đang dùng').
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Thêm vào danh sách đang dùng</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #003152; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; border: none; transition: transform 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1), background-color 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #00243d; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #003152; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Severity Banner
components.description: Highest-tier dose-safety warning. Flat, serious, no bounce or decorative motion — the system's protected zone.
components.html:
GẤP 10 LẦN LIỀU THƯỜNG DÙNG

Kiểm tra lại dấu thập phân hoặc sai đơn vị.
components.css: .ds-danger-banner { background: #fef2f2; border: 1px solid #fecaca; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; color: #b91c1c; } .ds-danger-banner strong { display: block; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 4px; }

narrative.overview: Every screen exists to answer one question fast and correctly, then get out of the way. The system is token-driven end to end — every color in the app reads from a --c-* CSS custom property, never a hardcoded hex — so a single palette swap recolors the entire product without touching component code. The palette is Deep Azure, replacing an earlier teal identity. The system deliberately draws a hard line between two zones: decoration (navigation, tabs, cards, screen transitions) and diagnosis (dose numbers, safety-tier colors, warning language). Delight lives entirely in the first zone; the second is untouchable.
keyCharacteristics: Every color is a CSS custom property; there are no hardcoded hex values in components.
Danger/warning/success semantics are colorblind-safe and are a separate, protected token family from the primary brand color.
Motion answers a specific question, with one exception zone (nav/tabs/cards) that now also carries brand personality.
Both light and dark mode are independently authored and contrast-verified, not generated by inverting one palette.

rules.name: The Untouchable Signal Rule
rules.body: --c-danger*, --c-warn*, and --c-green* are a separate token family from --c-primary*/--c-accent* and are never restyled, retinted, or animated as part of a brand refresh.

rules.name: The Decoration/Diagnosis Split Rule
rules.body: Delight is scoped to navigation, tabs, cards, and screen transitions. Dose numbers and safety-tier text stay calm by comparison.

rules.name: The 16px Floor Rule
rules.body: No input, textarea, or select ever renders below 16px font size, without exception.

rules.name: The Floating-Layer-Only Rule
rules.body: box-shadow appears only on elements genuinely elevated above the page (dropdowns, toasts, modals, sheets); a resting card never has one.

dos: Do read every color from a --c-* CSS custom property.
Do keep --c-danger*, --c-warn*, and --c-green* completely independent of the primary/accent palette.
Do verify new color pairs against WCAG AA before shipping them.
Do keep tap-confirmation motion working even under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do scope new delight/motion additions to navigation, tabs, cards, and transitions.
donts: Don't add bounce, pop, or celebratory motion to a danger or warning state, ever.
Don't use the Mindmap-only magenta accent anywhere in the medication or dosing screens.
Don't let any input, textarea, or select render below 16px font size.
Don't invert one theme to produce the other.
